title: Runnable, but not by everyone
briefing: deploy.sh should run for you and your team, but strangers shouldn't even see inside it.
tips: `chmod 750` = owner rwx, group r-x, others nothing.
objective: Set ~/deploy.sh to: owner read+write+execute, group read+execute, others no access.
hints: Owner needs all three (7). Group needs read and execute (5). Others get nothing (0).
explanation: Symbolic chmod (u+x, go-w) tweaks bits; octal (750) sets them all at once. 7=rwx, 5=r-x, 0=---. Give exactly the access needed and no more — that's the principle of least privilege.
